authority.description: Authoritative Phase B0 design after reviewer clarification that global prefixes require at least four characters.

b0_evidence_corrections.cause: The B0 probe did not skip the PHP ampersand token before by-reference function names.
b0_evidence_corrections.architecture_impact: none; both use Strategy 1 in B3 and add no new compatibility class.

b1_corrections.cause: The original B1 add-on map inventoried functions, hooks, retained physical identifiers, and handles but did not semantically compare add-on PHP against every B2-owned class, interface, constant, and request-global symbol.
b1_corrections.correction: A token-based five-add-on rescan freezes seven exact B2 dependencies across vms-events-slider, vms-data-tools, and vms-express-bar.
b1_corrections.architecture_impact: B2 requires isolated coordinated add-on cutovers before the core symbol rename; no public-package legacy aliases are introduced.

b1_corrections.cause: The original B1 inventory used a bounded loader-name list and did not model the global WordPress template-loader scope of the vendor-profile template.
b1_corrections.correction: B2.5 records and prefixes 38 vendor-template globals plus three loader globals through an explicit old-to-new map.
b1_corrections.architecture_impact: The historical B2 map and ratchet remain immutable; a separate complete semantic ledger and scanner-row inventory govern B2.5 and later batches.

b4_evidence_corrections.cause: B0 counted only uppercase window.VMS_* contracts and omitted shipped localized, camel-case API, and request-local window properties.
b4_evidence_corrections.architecture_impact: Additive B4 producer/consumer inventory only; no B0-B3 runtime architecture changes.

b4_evidence_corrections.cause: The historical probe did not freeze row-level handle membership, missed seven data-flow dependency sites, and overcounted two identities.
b4_evidence_corrections.architecture_impact: The approved bvmgr-* target remains; only exact membership and consumer accounting change.

b4_evidence_corrections.corrected_classification: The sole exact occurrence is a retained admin-page parent slug; semantic asset-API consumers are zero.
b4_evidence_corrections.evidence: Disposable add-on includes/class-vms-raf-plugin.php detect_vms_parent_slug() candidate list; enqueue dependency arrays are empty.
b4_evidence_corrections.architecture_impact: No B4 add-on patch and no dependency-only legacy handle alias are required.

b4_evidence_corrections.cause: The historical total was hard-coded without row identities. Token scans at the manifest-introduction commit and authorized B4 starting HEAD both produce the same 154 static actions; no two missing identifiers exist.
b4_evidence_corrections.architecture_impact: The approved nonce compatibility strategy remains unchanged; invented rows are forbidden.

strategy_definitions.6: Retain the historical physical storage identifier.
strategy_definitions.7: Remove an obsolete identifier after its evidence-based gate.

migration_state.network_model: Enumerate sites and run the same site-local state machine; no network-wide marker may mask an incomplete site.
migration_state.idempotency: Completed step IDs and the final marker are checked before work; reruns skip verified steps.
migration_state.interruption_retry: Persist current step and completed steps before/after each transition; retry the incomplete step.
migration_state.rollback: Retain legacy reads and values; mirror only explicitly safe writes or use a tested reverse projector.

compatibility_policies.canonical_legacy_mapping: Every entry/family provides current_identifier and canonical_target.
compatibility_policies.dual_read: Read canonical first, then exact legacy identifier while its compatibility gate is active.
compatibility_policies.canonical_write: Write canonical after copy verification; optionally mirror only rollback-safe values.
compatibility_policies.dual_fire_register: Canonical contract first, then deprecated legacy contract with identical arguments/handlers.
compatibility_policies.deprecation_tracking: Reason-coded per family; never use a blanket residual allowlist.

private_bridge_contract.trigger: A proven unknown private integration cannot coordinate the canonical cutover.
private_bridge_contract.distribution: Separately distributed private compatibility plugin only.
private_bridge_contract.behavior: Map only the frozen 13 legacy PHP entry points/types to canonical equivalents after canonical availability checks.
private_bridge_contract.removal_gate: All identified private consumers have moved to canonical APIs.
